jobs.description:
Location: Ebikon, Lucerne, Switzerland
Job ID: 82887

We Elevate... You

Join Schindler and help us elevate our world: Use your skills to allow megacities to grow. With our elevators and escalators, we keep the urban world moving.

Since 1874 Schindler has been a Citymaker with proud reputation for elevating not only buildings, but the well-being of everyone who lives and works in them. People, passion, and innovation are the pillars of our success.

Schindler is one of the world's leading suppliers of elevators, escalators and moving walkways. We employ talented individuals in over 100 countries worldwide to design, develop, install, maintain and modernize the mobility systems that keep the world's urban population on the move. We offer a dynamic, forward-looking work environment that enables our employees to innovate and excel in their chosen fields.

Join us as a

Recruiter (m/f/d) 100%

Are you passionate about people, curious about recruiting, and ready to take the next step in your career?

For our central headquarters of Schindler Switzerland in Ebikon, we are looking for a motivated Recruiter with potential who wants to grow within our HR Organisation.Whether you already have some recruiting experience or have gained your first exposure to HR and would like to specialize in recruitment, this role offers you the opportunity to learn, take responsibility and develop your expertise in a professional Talent Acquisition environment.

Your Role

As part of our HR team at the Schindler Switzerland headquarters in Ebiko n , you will take ownership of recruitment processes for a variety of positions across our Swiss organization. Working closely with experienced Talent Acquisition colleagues, hiring managers and HR partners, you will learn how to identify the right talent, provide an excellent candidate experience and contribute to high-quality hiring decisions. As your experience grows, so will your responsibilities, giving you the opportunity to develop into a trusted recruiting partner for the business.

Your Responsibilities

• Manage and coordinate recruitment processes, from job briefing and advertisement through candidate selection, interviews and hiring.

• Partner with hiring managers to understand their recruitment needs and support them throughout the selection process.

• Screen applications and conduct interviews to identify candidates' competencies, motivation and potential.

• Proactively identify and approach suitable candidates through LinkedIn and other sourcing channels.

• Build and maintain talent pipelines for recurring and future recruitment needs.

• Ensure a professional, engaging and positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.

• Learn and apply structured interviewing and modern selection and assessment methods.

• Work with our Applicant Tracking System and recruiting platforms to ensure accurate and efficient recruitment processes.

• Use recruiting data and market insights to continuously improve your approach.

• Contribute your ideas to Talent Attraction projects and initiatives, including employer branding, digitalization and process improvement.

• Continuously develop your recruiting expertise with the support of experienced colleagues and the wider HR organization.

Your Profile

• Completed commercial training, Bachelor's degree or comparable qualification, ideally with exposure to Human Resources.

• First professional experience in recruiting, HR, Talent Acquisition, an agency environment or another people-focused role is an advantage.

• Genuine interest in recruitment and motivation to build your career in Talent Acquisition.

• Strong communication skills and confidence in interacting with candidates and hiring managers.

• Curiosity about people and the ability to recognize competencies, motivation and potential.

• Interest in sourcing, social media recruiting and modern recruitment technologies.

• Digital affinity and willingness to learn recruiting systems and tools such as SAP SuccessFactors and LinkedIn Recruiter.

• Full fluency in German and good command of English, French is an advantage.

• Structured, reliable and proactive working style.

• Strong willingness to learn, openness to feedback and motivation to continuously develop.

• A positive, collaborative attitude and enthusiasm for delivering a great candidate and hiring manager experience.

We Elevate...Your Development

At Schindler, we don't expect you to know everything from day one. What matters to us is your potential, curiosity and willingness to learn.

You will work alongside experienced Talent Acquisition professionals, gain exposure to different areas of our business and progressively take on more complex recruitment responsibilities.

We will support you in developing your skills in sourcing, interviewing, assessment, stakeholder management and data-driven recruiting, providing you with a strong foundation for your future career in Talent Acquisition.

Can You Elevate Us?

Be part of a highly driven organization where high performance connects people and is a vital part of achieving strong business results. Please send us your complete application documents (CV, Reference Letters and University Diplomas).

www.schindler.com

Con i nostri ascensori e scale mobili, teniamo il mondo urbano in movimento. Dal 1874 Schindler è un Citymaker con orgogliosa reputazione per elevare non solo edifici, ma il benessere di tutti coloro che vivono e lavorano in loro. Persone, passione e innovazione sono i pilastri del nostro successo. Schindler è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di ascensori, scale mobili e passerelle in movimento. Usiamo individui di talento in oltre 100 paesi in tutto il mondo per progettare, sviluppare, installare, mantenere e modernizzare i sistemi di mobilità che mantengono la popolazione urbana del mondo in movimento. Offriamo un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e previsionale che consente ai nostri dipendenti di innovare ed eccellere nei loro campi scelti. Unisciti a noi come Talent Attraction Expert (m/f/d) 80-100% Ti avvicini a reclutare con una mentalità strategica, agisci in modo mirato e orientato alla qualità, e a operare come partner affidabile per i leader senior? Se è così, questo ruolo offre un'opportunità per professionisti esperti di acquisizione di talento con ambizione e proprietà. Il tuo ruolo Si assumerà la responsabilità end-to-end per riempire posizioni complesse e business-critical. Agendo come consulente strategico per i dirigenti, si forma attivamente moderni standard di reclutamento e garantire un equilibrio ottimale tra qualità, velocità e un'eccellente esperienza candidato. Le tue responsabilità
• La piena proprietà del ciclo di vita di reclutamento, dall'analisi delle esigenze e dall'aspirazione attraverso la selezione, l'intervista e l'assunzione
• Consulenza strategica per dirigenti e dirigenti di assunzione sulla pianificazione della forza lavoro, tendenze del mercato del lavoro e strategie di reclutamento efficaci
• Sourcing attivo così come lo sviluppo sostenibile e la manutenzione di pool di talenti attraverso canali pertinenti
• Applicazione professionale dei moderni metodi di selezione e valutazione (ad esempio, interviste strutturate, studi di casi, strumenti psicometrici) per valutare competenze, potenzialità e vestibilità culturale
• Ottimizzazione continua dei processi di reclutamento, degli strumenti e degli standard in linea con gli sviluppi del mercato e le migliori pratiche
• Contributo attivo e parziale leadership di progetti interfunzionali nel reclutamento, digitalizzazione e miglioramento della qualità Il tuo profilo
• Formazione commerciale completata o qualificazione comparabile, idealmente con un focus sulle risorse umane
• Minimo 5-10 anni di esperienza professionale nel reclutamento in-house o un ruolo simile Talent Acquisizione
• Forte competenza nella valutazione dell'attitudine e fiducia nella valutazione della personalità, della competenza e dei profili potenziali
• Competenze di consulenza pronunciate e una presenza professionale e credibile quando si lavora con dirigenti e candidati
• Comando molto forte delle soluzioni ATS (ad esempio, SAP SuccessFactors) oltre a piattaforme di reclutamento e social media
• Piena fluenza in tedesco e inglese. Il francese è altamente desiderabile.
• Stile di lavoro indipendente, strutturato e orientato ai risultati
• Standard di alta qualità, un forte senso di proprietà e un autentico entusiasmo per lo sviluppo continuo di pratiche di reclutamento Perché Schindler? Avrai accesso immediato a una varietà di vantaggi lavorando per un datore di lavoro TOP:
• Offriamo una posizione in un settore orientato al futuro con una gamma di prodotti diversificata, nonché remunerazione attraente e legata alle prestazioni
• Opportunità di sviluppo: inizierai con un programma di onboarding specifico per il lavoro e sarà supportato da noi attraverso programmi di sviluppo di competenze tecniche e morbide
• Equilibrio della vita lavorativa: Vi sosteniamo nella gestione della vostra vita professionale e personale attraverso orari di lavoro flessibili
• Vantaggi aziendali: Avrai l'opportunità di beneficiare di interessanti sconti per i dipendenti
• Diversità: Promuoviamo e adottiamo una cultura della diversità Puoi elevarci? Essere parte di un'organizzazione altamente guidato dove alte prestazioni collega le persone ed è una parte vitale del raggiungimento di forti risultati aziendali. Inviateci i vostri documenti di candidatura completi (CV, Lettere di Riferimento e Diploma Universitari). www.schindler.com

Für unser Global Legal & Compliance-Team suchen wir einen erfahrenen Anwalt, der Schindlers globale Wachstumsagenda unterstützt. In dieser Funktion arbeiten Sie an M&A-Transaktionen, beraten im Kartell- und Wettbewerbsrecht und helfen bei der Umsetzung komplexer gesetzlicher Anforderungen in eine praktische Anleitung für das Unternehmen.

Was macht diese ideale Rolle für starke Kandidaten attraktiv: Die Rolle verbindet Transaktionsarbeit, Wettbewerbsrecht, internationales Engagement und die enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsinteressenten in einem globalen Industrieunternehmen. Die Position eignet sich gut für jemanden, der intellektuell anspruchsvolle juristische Arbeit, pragmatische Geschäftsberatung und eine Teamkultur genießt, die auf Professionalität, Vertrauen und Integrität basiert.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Unterstützung von M&A-Transaktionen von der frühen Strukturierung durch Due Diligence, Vertragsdokumentation, Verhandlungen, Fusionskontrolle und Integration nach Abschluss

• Beratung im Kartell- und Wettbewerbsrecht im gesamten Geschäft von Schindler, einschließlich Neuinstallationen, bestehender Installationen, Modernisierungen, Reparaturen, Beschaffung, Lieferkette und digitaler Aktivitäten

• Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern, externen Beratern und Behörden weltweit in Bezug auf Fusionskontrolle, Untersuchungen und andere regulatorische oder gesellschaftsrechtliche Angelegenheiten

• Bereitstellung praktischer rechtlicher Beiträge zur externen Kommunikation, zur Wettbewerbspositionierung bei Transaktionen und darüber hinaus sowie zu anderen geschäftskritischen Initiativen

• Überwachung der rechtlichen und regulatorischen Entwicklungen und Bewertung ihrer Auswirkungen auf Transaktionen, Geschäftsvorgänge und Strategie

• Entwickeln Sie zielgerichtete, benutzerfreundliche Schulungen, Richtlinien und Best Practices, die Geschäftsteams dabei helfen, rechtliche und Compliance-Anforderungen effektiv anzuwenden

Wir erhöhen... Dein bestes Selbst

• Jurastudium, vorzugsweise von einer Schweizer Universität, und Zulassung als Rechtsanwalt; LL.M., Doktorat oder internationale Erfahrung

• 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung im Gesellschaftsrecht, M&A und/oder Wettbewerbsrecht (Kanzlei und/oder intern)

• Fähigkeit, schnell Fachwissen zu entwickeln und strukturierte, pragmatische Lösungen in einem schnelllebigen Geschäftsumfeld zu liefern

• Unternehmerisches Mindset mit starkem Fokus auf praktische, kundenorientierte Rechts- und Compliance-Lösungen

• Ausgezeichnetes juristisches Englisch und Deutsch (C2 – Proficient), zusätzliche Sprachen sind ein Plus

Begleiten Sie Schindler und helfen Sie uns, unsere Welt zu verbessern: Nutzen Sie Ihre Fähigkeiten, damit Megastädte wachsen können. Mit unseren Aufzügen und Fahrtreppen halten wir die urbane Welt in Bewegung.

Seit 1874 ist Schindler ein Citymaker mit dem stolzen Ruf, nicht nur Gebäude, sondern auch das Wohlergehen aller, die darin leben und arbeiten, zu erhöhen. Menschen, Leidenschaft und Innovation sind die Säulen unseres Erfolgs.

Schindler ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Aufzügen, Fahrtreppen und Fahrsteigen. Wir beschäftigen talentierte Mitarbeiter in über 100 Ländern weltweit, um die Mobilitätssysteme zu entwerfen, zu entwickeln, zu installieren, zu warten und zu modernisieren, die die städtische Bevölkerung der Welt in Bewegung halten. Wir bieten ein dynamisches, zukunftsorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld, das es unseren Mitarbeitern ermöglicht, in ihren ausgewählten Bereichen innovativ zu sein und sich zu profilieren.

Begleiten Sie uns als A

Working Student (m/w/d) IT Application Support (50-60%)

Wir erhöhen... Ihre Aufgaben

• Aktive Einbindung in das Application Management: Pflege und Weiterentwicklung des bestehenden Anwendungsportfolios, Bearbeitung neuer Anwendungsanforderungen und Verwaltung des End-to-End-Prozesses für alle Software-Erneuerungen

• Beratung und Unterstützung von CRD-Nutzern und unabhängiges Management von Eskalationen

• Koordination mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern (CRD, SIS und andere) und Unterstützung des Betriebsteams im Tagesgeschäft

• Erstellung und Pflege von Prozessdokumentationen, Anleitungen, Checklisten und Knowledge Base Artikeln (CTO-IT)

• Analyse der Lizenznutzung zur Optimierung des CTO-Anwendungsportfolios sowie Beitrag zur Projekt- und Anforderungsanalyse

Wir erhöhen... Dein bestes Selbst

• Derzeit in einem Studiengang in Informatik oder Business IT eingeschrieben

• Einige frühere Arbeitserfahrungen sind von Vorteil - Sie arbeiten unabhängig, übernehmen Eigentümerschaft und sind ein zuverlässiger Teamplayer

• Starke Kommunikations- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit kundenorientiertem Ansatz

• Gutes Zeitmanagement und die Fähigkeit, effektiv über mehrere Aufgaben zu priorisieren

• Deutsch und Englisch (gesprochen und geschrieben)

• Vielfalt: Wir fördern und fördern eine Kultur der Vielfalt

Location: Ebikon, Lucerne, Switzerland
Job ID: 90955

We Elevate... Quality of urban life

More than two billion people rely on Schindler every day. Our many years of experience and innovative strength make us the number one in the Swiss lift and escalator business. As part of the Schindler family, you make places more accessible, inclusive and sustainable for everyone. We combine innovation, safety, inclusion and diversity within the company. Become part of our 150-year success story and help shape the future of mobility.

Join us as a

Global Finance Transformation Manager (m/f/d) 100%

Ready to shape the future of Finance on a global scale?

Join us in driving the transformation of our global Finance landscape. As Global Finance Transformation Manager, you will play a key role in our SAP S/4HANA journey and lead strategic initiatives across Finance, data, reporting, and technology involving Power BI and CCH Tagetik.

As part of Global Finance Reporting Solutions, you will collaborate with stakeholders worldwide to deliver scalable solutions, drive reporting excellence and finance processes, and contribute to the future of Finance in an international environment.

Your Impact

•
Drive Finance requirements and play a leading role in the SAP S/4HANA transformation, with a focus on Financial Steering, Universal Journal, Margin Analysis, Material Ledger, and Product Costing.

•
Lead global cross-functional transformation initiatives involving SAP, Power BI, and CCH Tagetik, including Sustainability and BEPS Pillar Two reporting.

•
Analyze Finance processes, reporting structures, and system dependencies, translating business needs into clear and practical solutions.

•
Partner with Global Finance stakeholders, Process Owners, IT teams, and external implementation partners to ensure successful project delivery.

•
Support the full project lifecycle while driving standardization, scalability, and continuous improvement across Finance processes, data, KPIs, and reporting.

•
Drive the standardization of reporting processes, structures, KPIs and data definitions, ensuring consistency across source systems, Finance data platforms and reporting solutions.

Who you are

You combine strong analytical and conceptual thinking with excellent stakeholder management skills. You can connect f inance, data, reporting, and technology to develop practical solutions and communicate complex topics clearly.

Your Profile

•
Degree in Finance, Accounting, Controlling, Business Administration, Business Information Systems, or a related field

•
Minimum 8 years of relevant professional experience in Finance, Finance Transformation, SAP projects, or business process management , i deal ly gaine d in an industrial multin ational company .

•
Hands-on experience with SAP ERP and/or SAP S/4HANA transformation projects and a strong understanding of end-to-end Finance and reporting processes.

•
Knowledge of SA P Financial Steering, management reporting, Universal Journal, Margin Analysis, Material Ledger, Product Costing, or similar Finance domains.

•
Experience with Power BI, CCH Tagetik, or comparable enterprise performance management, planning, consolidation, or analytics solutions, as well as managing complex international projects.

•
Fluent English and the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders

Chef de projet Bussigny (h/f/d) 80-100% chez Schindler à Bussigny.

Le groupe Schindler est l'un des principaux fabricants mondiaux d'ascenseurs, d'escaliers mécaniques et de passerelles mobiles. Fondée en Suisse en 1874, l'entreprise emploie environ 70 000 personnes dans le monde, dont plusieurs milliers en Suisse. Schindler offre un environnement de travail moderne, des conditions d'emploi attrayantes, des possibilités de formation diversifiées et des perspectives de carrière dans une société suisse de technologie ayant son siège à Ebikon (Canton de Lucerne).
